requirements: Prefer English-language base models and English instruction checkpoints.
Keep model adapters optional and lazy-loaded; the symbolic core must run without downloading weights.
Translate non-English user input into English before model inference; preserve the original alongside the normalized text.
Translate user-facing questions back to the requested language after inference.
Do not silently substitute a non-English base model.
Record model ID, revision, tokenizer ID, prompt language, output language, and translation adapter in every model-assisted session.
The core Muse engine remains non-generative; model-assisted drafting is a separately gated optional module.
note: Candidates are configuration defaults, not claims that weights are installed, available offline, or validated for this project.
